summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by capturing agentic journeys through the Quadrature Nexus and FLUME VAE with SurrealDB persistence, then analyzing those journeys via Ouroboros and Mycelium to feed synthesized patterns back into improving the system, culminating in a scaled overnight autoresearch loop.
summary.outcome: Delivered E1-E113 autoresearch experiments, reduced test suite failures from ~49 to 2 pre-existing ones, shipped 10+ compound analytics modules, fixed FLUME VAE dual-mode architecture, added E57 additive calibration fix for Mycelium compounding, wired compound_score into ExecutionResult, and deployed anti-sycophancy measures in the e80 reflective autoresearch loop.

repo: SurrealDB v3 HTTP /sql endpoint hangs on any request with surreal-db header — use SURREAL_DISABLE=1 env var as bypass; only context-free queries (RETURN, INFO FOR ROOT) reliably return
autoresearch.jsonl is an LFS-tracked runtime log causing pointer/content conflicts with pre-commit stash; must be in .gitignore and untracked with git rm --cached
Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically commits working tree state to orphan branches and resets working directory — workaround is git checkout HEAD -- <file> to restore
conftest.py globally mocks transformers but only exposes PreTrainedConfig/PreTrainedModel as real; PreTrainedTokenizer was MagicMock causing FlumeTokenizer.__call__ to return empty items
The resource guardrail reads real psutil CPU/memory — on a busy machine (99.4% CPU from agents) it blocks every CompoundExecutor test; both psutil.cpu_percent AND virtual_memory must be mocked
CostAwareRouter has class-level _profiles_cache that never resets between tests — added reset_singleton() that also clears cache
QuadratureNexus._score_adjustments is overwritten per-deliberation by run_llm_deliberation(); _mycelium_calibration is the persistent cross-cycle accumulator; feedback must use += not =
SentenceTransformer is always mocked in the test environment to prevent AMD hardware segfault; tests expecting real ST must use requires_real_st skip marker
KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 env var needed to commit kaggle-related source files on main branch
FlumeVAE forward() signature changed from 4-value (recon, mu, log_var, z) to 3-value and back to 4-value during refactor — callers that unpack 4 values break when it returns 3
config/model_profiles.yaml is a production routing config — tier_simple controls which Lemonade model handles requests; changing it affects live behavior
Pre-commit hooks silently abort commits when any staged file has lint violations — ruff format + ruff check --fix must be run manually before staging to prevent silent failures

code.finding: E57 fix: apply_mycelium_feedback must use += accumulation into _mycelium_calibration (not SET semantics); also added _detect_oscillation() that halves effective_lr when last 3 adjustments alternate sign

Real HTTP client required (was fully simulated); probe must use 'RETURN true;' not 'SELECT 1;'; datetime fields need time::now() not string literals; SCHEMAFULL blocks arbitrary metadata subfields so EVO biography goes in result field as JSON string
forward() returns (recon, mu, log_var, z) — 4 values; reparameterize() returns mu deterministically in eval mode; legacy MLP mode available via FlumeVAE(input_dim=768, latent_dim=256)
Must use 4-value unpack: recon, mu, logvar, _z = self.model(data); reconstruction cosine similarity for token models uses recon.argmax(dim=-1).float() not raw logits tensor
compound_score = coherence * hiho_stability * skill_factor wired before return; hiho_stability = max(0, 1 - 2*|coherence - 0.5|) penalizes extremes; skill_factor = max(0, 1 + skill_gain)

Must patch httpx.AsyncClient not httpx.Client in tests; use AsyncMock for post and aclose; all vault_* methods are async requiring asyncio.run() in unittest.TestCase; vault_write_sync/read_sync/delete_sync are sync wrappers using loop detection pattern
vault_find_relevant_context is async and was called without await; must use vault_search() sync wrapper instead

_MockVirtualMemory must include percent=50.0, total=128GiB, available=64GiB; AND psutil.cpu_percent must be mocked to 25.0 — missing CPU mock causes resource guardrail to block all compound executor tests on busy machines
Race condition: _flush_batch task runs concurrently with flush_all causing double-writes; save task handle in _schedule_flush, cancel it at start of flush_all before processing

log_result() takes 6 positional args: (run: int, metric: float, metrics: dict, status: str, description: str, experiment: str); autoresearch.jsonl stores experiment label at r['asi']['experiment'] not r['experiment'], and status at r['status'] not r['verdict']

workflow: Surgical commit pattern: ruff format + ruff check --select=F,E9,E501 --fix manually first, then git add <specific files> (never git add -A which risks staging secrets or LFS data files)
When pre-commit stash/restore conflicts with LFS or runtime files, use git stash push --keep-index then git stash pop after commit; or move the conflicting file out temporarily
AsyncMock + asyncio.run() is the correct pattern for async MCPClient in unittest.TestCase (which cannot be async def); patching httpx.Client instead of httpx.AsyncClient is a silent failure
timeit.default_timer() is the correct timer for microsecond experiment timing (alias for time.perf_counter, unaffected by NTP)
V-model structural invariant tests using inspect.signature() catch refactor drift at ~1ms each without running actual code
Retirement criterion for autoresearch experiments: CV(last-10-keeps) < 0.05 = converged; 0 keeps after N runs = noise; CV uses keep metric values not discard
HIHO threshold 0.5: exploit (coherence >= 0.5) vs explore (below); applies to AutoresearchEngine.generate_next_experiments mode selection
The conftest.py psutil mock pattern must cover BOTH virtual_memory AND cpu_percent — memory-only mock still allows CPU guardrail to block tests on loaded machines
Anti-sycophancy: unanimous council votes should trigger re-probe with adversarial prompt at higher temperature; store unanimous_divergence flag in vault for downstream analysis
